title: Piquant pie
content:
# Piquant pie

Type: Food | Internal ID: PiquantPie | Source: Stone oven | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Uncooked piquant pie x1 | Max Health: 105 | Max Stamina: 35 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 6 hp/tick

# Introduction

Piquant pie is an Ashlands-tier food.

## Recipe

• Uncooked piquant pie is crafted at a Food preparation table with: 2 Vineberry cluster 2 Asksvin tail 4 Barley flour.
• Piquant pie is produced by baking Uncooked piquant pie dough in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn into Coal.

## Notes

• Piquant pie provides the highest health gain of any food item in the game at 105.
• Pronounced ˈpēk(w)ənt

Categorias: Food, Materials
